title: Encoded PowerShell command
scope: Process invocation with -enc or -EncodedCommand; not all aliases; not a verdict of maliciousness.

title: schtasks task-registration command
scope: schtasks.exe /Create invocation; does not itself prove task creation succeeded; other registration APIs not covered.

title: Local Administrators membership added
scope: 4732 for group SID S-1-5-32-544; legitimate administration can also match.

title: Run-key value set
scope: Sysmon 13 for configured CurrentVersion Run path; no claim for every autostart location or future execution.

title: certutil Base64 file decoding
scope: certutil.exe -decode invocation; no claim that decoded content is malicious; -decodehex not covered.

title: New account added to local Administrators
scope: 4720 then 4732 for the same host and account SID within 10 minutes; authorization must still be investigated.
